issue: Three application-site AEs are each recorded twice with identical start/end dates (2013-12-10 to 2013-12-21), once as MODERATE/NOT RECOVERED and once as SEVERE/RECOVERED; the NOT RECOVERED records also carry an end date.
query_text: Application site erythema (AE 3 and AE 6), application site pruritus (AE 2 and AE 5) and application site warmth (AE 4 and AE 7) are each recorded twice. Both records in each pair have a start date of 2013-12-10 and an end date of 2013-12-21. In each pair, one record is MODERATE with outcome NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED and the other is SEVERE with outcome RECOVERED/RESOLVED. Please confirm whether these are separate events or a change in severity of one event. If severity changed, please give the date of each severity change so the records do not overlap. Please also confirm the outcome of the MODERATE records, because an end date of 2013-12-21 does not match NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED.

issue: Disposition is ADVERSE EVENT, but no AE record has an action taken entered, so the AE that led to discontinuation cannot be identified.
query_text: The Disposition form records the reason for discontinuation as ADVERSE EVENT (dated 2014-01-31, Week 8 visit), and the last dose was on 2013-12-14. However, "action taken with study drug" is blank for all 7 AE records, including the application site erythema, pruritus and warmth events that started on 2013-12-10. Please identify which adverse event(s) led to discontinuation and complete the action taken for those records (e.g. drug withdrawn). Please also confirm whether the disposition date of 2014-01-31 is correct, given that the last dose was on 2013-12-14.
